subject: general
question: At a health club, 80% of the members are men and the remaining 20% are women. The average age of the male members is 30 years and the average age of the female members is 40 years. The combined average age of all the members of this health club is _______ years.
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of male members = 80%

Percentage of female members = 20%

Average age of male members = 30 years

Average age of female members = 40 years

**Formula Used:**

Combined average age = (Sum of ages of all members) / (Total number of members)

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of members be 100 (for simplicity).

Number of male members = 80% of 100 = 80

Number of female members = 20% of 100 = 20

Sum of ages of male members = 80 × 30 = 2400

Sum of ages of female members = 20 × 40 = 800

Sum of ages of all members = 2400 + 800 = 3200

Total number of members = 100

Combined average age = 3200 / 100

Combined average age = 32 years

**The combined average age of all the members of this health club is 32 years.**
